## DecodeContext.bindReference() method

Produce a reference bound to the decoding client from its decoded data.

**Signature:**

```typescript
bindReference(reference: ReferenceData): ObjectReferenceVariant<unknown> | CollectionReferenceVariant<unknown>;
```

## Remarks

`reference` carries identifiers decoded through the app's resource table, selector positions as `Integer`<!-- -->, and any containers (and identity collection entries) as nested data. The result must be the bound form of the same variant (same resource, form, and cardinality, with the same data fields), with nested containers and entries bound as well, so that the result is itself valid encode input.
